Advance the Story

When you meet an Episode Progression Requirement while exploring， an episode will become available immediately after the exploration ends.

If you have already met an Episode Progression Requirement， you can also Advance the Story using the button in the bottom-right corner of the Story screen.
You can check your current Episode Progression Requirements in the same place， in the bottom-right corner of the Story screen.

About the Storage Shelf

You can store supplies you find while exploring on the Storage Shelf.
There is a limit to the number of items you can carry as supplies during exploration， so storing them on the Storage Shelf is a good idea.

About Crafting

You can use tools and ingredients gathered while exploring to craft new tools and dishes.
You can view the list of crafting recipes using the Crafting button.

About Explorer

Select an Episode and set out on an Exploration.
By meeting an Episode Progression Requirement during an exploration， an episode will become available.

About Exploration Locations

Once you have visited an exploration location， it will be registered as a Starting Point， allowing you to begin explorations from that location.
(Some exploration locations cannot be registered as Starting Points.)

Beyond the Summer

The post-ending content， Beyond the Summer， has been unlocked.
Even after the story ends， their world continues inside this computer.
You can continue traveling with them along their summer journey， forever.

Previously Unlocked Content

In Beyond the Summer， you can view episodes that were not unlocked in the main story，
as well as collect items and episodes exclusive to the post-ending content.

Camp Sites

While exploring in Beyond the Summer， you may come across a Camp Site.
At Camp Sites， you may find rare items such as Collections that let you watch mini-episodes.
As you travel from Camp Site to Camp Site， the journey continues without end.

Daily Rewards

After the ending， you will receive a Daily Reward once per day.
With a Daily Reward， you can receive one random item each day.
(There are no items or other content that can only be obtained through Daily Rewards.)
